## What needs to change?
- [ ] Tool facts (`src/data/tools.json`)
- [ ] Questions (`src/data/questions.json`)
- [ ] Rules/weights (`src/data/rules.json`)

## Proposed change
Describe the change clearly and link to sources.

## Sources
Provide primary/official sources for facts (links required).

## Rationale
Why this change is needed and how it improves accuracy or clarity.

## Impact
Who or what does this affect?
